# Setup for every vector: 4 lanes on 2 substreams (A = lanes 0-1, B = lanes 2-3), no
# pool, epoch 1, book 1, tenure 0, sequencer index 0 with the seq_key below, no fence.
# `frame <now_ns> <hex>` delivers one frame received at now_ns; `tick <now_ns>` runs
# the REP_E_HASHLAG timer (1 ms). Then every `expect` must hold:
#   ready <k>                 k blocks are ready for replay and there is no fault
#   fault <code> stream <s> frame <n> height <h>
#                             the first fault: its REP_E_* code (HEADER for header
#                             rules), the frame that showed it, the first height that
#                             loses its vote
#   verdict <first> <last> <Valid|Invalid|Pending>   07 §6.4 items 2 and 5
#   cuts <c0.c1.c2.c3> ...    the full cut of each step of the first ready block
